ledger_triggers.name: trg_chip_ledger_performed_by
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_chip_ledger_performed_by BEFORE INSERT ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_chip_ledger_performed_by()

ledger_triggers.name: trg_chip_ledger_performed_by_update
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER trg_chip_ledger_performed_by_update BEFORE UPDATE OF performed_by ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION enforce_chip_ledger_performed_by()

ledger_triggers.name: zz_freeze_guard
ledger_triggers.definition: CREATE TRIGGER zz_freeze_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.chip_ledger FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION fn_refuse_while_frozen()
